mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concert_schedules (concert_id, concert_date, reservation_open_at, total_seats, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{concertId}, #{concertDate}, #{reservationOpenAt}, #{totalSeats}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, concert_id, concert_date, reservation_open_at, total_seats, created_at, updated_at FROM concert_schedules WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
